title: Staff can set a price on one of Frequency's own events from the edit form, the same as the ticket and tier paths allow

source.ref: Meta scan eight (2026-10-12), pricing ladder review of #3277 (LIVE-753).

detail: FILED AND CLOSED 2026-10-12. THE CONSEQUENCE: the event edit action asked the payments gate about resolveHostingSpaceIdFromRow, which collapses the root Space to null, so a price on a root-hosted event hit the personal-seller refusal. The ticket buy path (lib/billing/tickets.ts) and the tier editor keep root as the payee, so the three money paths disagreed and staff saw an upgrade message on Frequency's own events. THE FIX: the edit path keeps root as the payee when the event's host_space_id is the root Space. LEFT: the create path, where root is not a placement a member can pick.

verify.cmd: node -e "const s=require('fs').readFileSync('app/(main)/events/actions.ts','utf8');if(!/root && evRow\.host_space_id === root \? root : await resolveHostingSpaceIdFromRow\(evRow\)/.test(s)){console.error('SCAN-819: a root-hosted event price is refused as a personal sale');process.exit(1)}"
